Sarah's password security practices have significant weaknesses. Using the same password for every account is risky because if one account is compromised, all other accounts using that same password are also vulnerable. Although she changes it monthly, this does not mitigate the risk of a single breach exposing all her credentials. Additionally, reusing passwords across multiple services is generally discouraged in favor of using unique, strong passwords for each account, ideally managed with a password manager.

A group of crows is called a murder.
